characters.name: Death / Shinigami
characters.description: The Grim Reaperand head of the DWMA. Most of the time he behaves like a complete goofball, but he can be a terrifyingly powerful fighting force when thingsget serious. His soul wavelength is so large that it covers all of Death City. Spirit Albarn is his current partner, much to the latter's constant annoyance. Anthropomorphic Personification: He anEldritch Abominationthat embodiesthe madness of order, who wascreated byShinra Kusakabeto establish new rules in the reality he created. Upon his birth,Death stripped everyone of their ability to use pyrokinesis and removed Infernals. Art Evolution:When Lord Death is first created by Shinra-Banshōman at the end ofFire Force, his appearance differs greatly from how he is depicted inSoul Eater. Initially, he has a more realistic and menacing skull-like mask, and his body consists of a semicircular form lined with several black spikes. InSoul Eater, however, his design is noticeably more cartoonish and humanoid. This change is likely the result of him choosing to adopt a friendlier and more approachable appearance centuries after his creation, reflecting his role as a guardian and overseer rather than a figure meant to inspire despair. Barrier Maiden:Limited to the foundations of the DWMA for the purposes of sealing the first Kishin. Asura got out, Death did not.Has something ofBarrier Warriortoo, as he tries to crush Asura with a shield. Limited to the foundations of the DWMA for the purposes of sealing the first Kishin. Asura got out, Death did not.

characters.name: Spirit Albarn
characters.description: Lord Death's current weapon and Maka's estranged but affectionate father. Maka's mother was his former meister, but she divorced him due to his constant flirting with other women. The Ace: It's easy to forget, given his ridiculous demeanor, but he's the strongest of the Death Scythes and Lord Death's personal weapon. Action Dad: What with being a Death Scythe and all. Adaptation Dye-Job: The anime gives him blue eyes, but in the manga his eyes are as green as Maka's. Amazingly Embarrassing Parent: To Maka.

characters.name: Sid Barett
characters.description: A zombie who was once a teacher and meister at DWMA. Post-mortem, he still serves Death faithfully, and he partners with Nygus in battle. He is named afterSyd BarrettfromPink Floyd. Back from the Dead: Already back to life as a zombie in the original series, but timeline wise following afterNot!, it counts. Blade Enthusiast: He's a Knife Meister, but he can also use other weapons (including Azusa Yumi and his own tombstone) without trouble. Catchphrase:"That's the kind of man I was."The anime version even gives him a brief pre-zombification cameo where he says "That's the man I am," instead. "That's the kind of man I was."

characters.name: Mira Nygus
characters.description: Sid's Demon Weapon partner, who took over as the school nurse after Medusa left. In keeping with her partner's undead theme, she looks like an Egyptian mummy. Her weapon form is a combat knife. Is revealed to have met Sid by being the prize of a lottery for partner-less meister. Adaptational Early Appearance: In the manga, she appears in her human form right after Arachne's revival, while in the anime she first appears with Sid as they go to check Medusa's lair. Booby Trap: Quite skilled at setting them, asMifunefound out. Hospital Hottie: She's the school nurse andshe's actually quite prettyunderneath the bandages. Icy Blue Eyes: Of the cold and piercing variety.

characters.name: Franken Stein
characters.description: Dr. Franken Stein is a teacher at the DWMA and the most powerful meister to ever graduate from the school. Memorable for being a textbookMad Scientist, albeit a heroic one. He was Spirit Albarn's first meister, until Spirit was driven off by Stein's obsession with dissecting anything and everything, including Spirit himself. Adaptational Villainy:In the manga he struggles with his madness andis suspected of a murder, but never betrays the DWMA. In the anime he actually pulls aFace–Heel Turnand joins Medusa, but comes back not too long after. Anti-Hero: Stein fights on the side of the heroes and he's staunchly loyal to Death, but his personal morals are... questionable, to put it lightly. Art Shift:Through the Eyes of Madness, things can get...trippy. Awesomeness by Analysis: Very intelligent and can focus his thoughts with the screw on his head.

characters.name: Marie Mjolnir
characters.description: The Death Scythe in charge of Oceania. Her weapon form is that of a large hammer (though partially resembles a tonfa), and her last name is derived from the legendary hammer ofThor,Mjölnir. She wears an eyepatch with a thunderbolt insignia. Action Girl: What with being a Death Scythe and all. Alliterative Name:MarieMjolnir Babies Ever After:With Stein. The extra soul wavelength in her womb is received quite well. The part where Stein declares the kid another guinea pig,not so much. Blemished Beauty: She's a beautiful woman with a missing eye which she covers with an eyepatch.

characters.name: Auntie/Old Lady
characters.description: Animal Motifs: Calls herself a "Gorilla." Bare-Fisted Monk: Apparently, Shinigami forbid her to carry a Weapon, because she was already too dangerous by herself. Big Damn Heroes: For Kid while on the moon, complete withDynamic Entry. Chekhov's Gunman: The first time we see her is when she gives Kilik and Ox their mission with the giant. Dropped a Bridge on Her:Justsecondsafter surviving her own attemptedHeroic Sacrificeand getting ready to resume the fight with Kaguya, she's attacked from behind, brutally impaled, and then her soul is extinguished.Goddammit, Justin.

characters.name: Hiro
characters.description: The most incompetent Meister at DWMA. Bullied and used by just about everyone at the school due to his doormat personality. He finds out about the legend of Excalibur, and becomes the only person since perhaps King Arthur to put up with the supremely annoying holy sword. In fact, heenjoysExcalibur's 1000 tenets, and becomes Excalibur's happy and devoted Meister. For about a day, that is. Anti-Role Model: He can be seen as an anti-DWMAmodel student in a sense that Hiro doesn't care about any of its causes beside looking cool. As seen with how he dedicated his time with Excalibur to show off and being a jerk rather than any humanitarian cause. Acquired Situational Narcissism: After he gets Excalibur and thereby becomes the strongest student in the school, heimmediatelystarts abusing his powers to beat up everyone who used to pick on him, teleport into the girls' shower, flip skirts... Back for the Finale: He makes a cameo in the last chapter duringKid's inauguration; appropriately enough it's of someone backing up into his face without noticing him. Badass Boast: "When all is said and done, the three of you will be nothing more than a footnote in the legend of the Holy Sword, Excalibur."

characters.name: Death Scythes in General
characters.description: Death Scythes are Demon Weapons who have been "forged." That is a Meister, or a collection of Meisters, have captured 99 evil human souls on Death's List and one witch soul and fed them to a candidate. Doing so creates Death Scythes who have qualities that the God of Death himself uses. Infinity +1 Sword: Death Scythes are characterized as being phenomenally more powerful than the average Demon Weapon, adopting powers based on the witch who's soul they've eaten and while they can be wielded by a human meister, are the preferred weapon for the God of Death. Non-Indicative Name: Sure, they're called "Death Scythes," but almost none of them are actually scythes.The number rises to two when Soul becomes one, but that does nothing to change the fact.

characters.name: Justin Law
characters.description: The Death Scythe in charge of Western Europe. His weapon form, the guillotine, fits his title of "executioner". He's usually seen wearing priestly garb and a pair of headphones that he keeps on at high volume. Adaptational Heroism:In the anime, he never turns out to be evil.Which also means he never died. Art Shift:After hisFace–Heel Turn, the panels depicting him grow steadily more warped and twisted. Badass Boast: Justin's bike tows a coffin—apparently for his targets. Showing up with one of these in tow is an implicit boast that it's going to be filled. Badass Preacher: Justin is a man of the cloth, and is every bit as badass as you would expect a Death Scythe to be.

characters.name: Yumi Azusa
characters.description: The Death Scythe in charge of East Asia. She is bookish and analytical and is close friends with Marie. In weapon form she takes the form of a crossbow, able to fire high-velocity spirit shots up to 10 km accurately. She is also an extremely competent information gatherer and tactician, easily finding one of Arachnophobia's labs. Big Damn Heroes:In chapter 111, right when it seems like Asura has won, Kilik and Azusa shoot Asura in the head all the way from Earth with some handy calculations from Eruka. It ends up being just the distraction that the heroes needed to turn the tables on Asura. Brutal Honesty: She didn't hesitate to tell Spirit and Stein what she thought about their failure to prevent Asura's revival. Even earlier, she gets clocked by Marie for telling her marriage woes aren't something she should be worried about. Cold Sniper: She's a very stoic, cool-headed individual. And sure enough, she takes the form of a sniper crossbow. In-Series Nickname: Called "The Queen of Commitee Chairman" by Spirit and Stein, due to her strict and bossy behaviour back as a student. Much to her dismay.

characters.name: Tezca Tlipoca
characters.description: Alliterative Name: By way of splitting the name of an Aztec deity down the middle. Badass Creed: "Life and death are bestowed equally on all people. I'm a mirror in which a person is reflected. So, how you die is up to you..." Cloudcuckoolander: Snaps between this and his competent badass persona in the blink of an eye. For example,after faking his death, he disguises himself by putting on a giantgopherhead. Crouching Moron, Hidden Badass: He wears a massive bear mask at all times and is a goofball with a somewhat questionable grasp on reality, but as a Death Scythe he's one of the strongest characters in the series.In his final fight he goes Meister-less against fellow Death Scythe and solo-Weapon expert Justin Lawfused with a Clown, a situation where Tezca should be at a massive disadvantage, and goes the distance before permanently scarring Justin, and it's implied that if he was more concerned with winning than trying to redeem Justin he could have killed him. Faking the Dead:Thought to have been unceremoniously bitten in half one of Noah's summons, but turns out he used a dummy to fake his death and track Justin Law. Justin Law later decapitated him and checked the body to make sure - the body was real, but Tezca's soul survived.

characters.name: Tsar Pushka
characters.description: Demon Slaying: One of only three characters in the series to be confirmed with the anti-demon wavelength. As noted by Medusa, he's particularly effective at fighting Crona as a result... up to a point. Epic Flail: Despite being called a "Cannon Bullet", he can also become a sort of flail (with his neck becoming a sort of chain). Meaningful Name: "Pushka" means "cannon" in Russian."Tsar pushka"is the largest bombard by caliber ever built. No Body Left Behind: Judging by both Maka's observation with her Soul Perception and Crona's own description after the factTsar's body was completely broken down into Black Blood after being consumed by the Mad Blood attack and all that's left is just his soul trapped in a Black Blood sphere. The Worf Effect: Like all the Death Weapons, Tsar isextremelypowerful and even comes with an anti-demon wavelength to make him even more dangerous to dark forces,which just goes to show how much stronger Crona has gotten after they easily take him out after unleashing the Mad Blood. Indeed, Medusa seems to have chosen him as Crona's target specifically to invoke this as a show of how far they've come.

characters.name: Ding Dinga
characters.description: Alliterative Name:DingDinga Light The Way: He can reflect back light beams and leaves large rainbows trails behind when swung. Rainbow Motif: Fittingly enough, in Africa rainbows are considered an omen of death.

characters.name: Djinn Galland
characters.description: The Faceless: His face behind his turban has never been shown. Genie in a Bottle: Him performing Soul Resonance with his meister creates one. Heart Symbol: The attack called "The Lovers." Probably also an example ofThe Power of Love. Meaningful Name: His last name is most likely a nod to Antoine Galland, the first European translator ofOne Thousand and One Nights. Tarot Motifs: Two of his forms are called Tower and Lovers and are stylized accordingly.

characters.name: Joe Buttataki
characters.description: Referred to as "Mole Hunter" Joe Buttataki, Joe is an ally of Shibusen and ex-boyfriend of Marie Mjolnir. Due to the anime'sGecko Endingthat split off after his introductory chapter, Joe plays a different role in it. In the anime, Joe was one of Shibusen's most talented scientists and engineers, and Shinigami pulls him back to Death City to help work on a black ops project involvingBREW. With the exception of his irrational love of coffee, little else of the character's background was kept from the manga. Accidental Pervert: When he's interviewing Marie, he detects Medusa's magic snake inside her body and leans in to get a closer look...but its location in her chest makes it look like he's eying her breasts (not helped by her deciding to put on a dress that displays her cleavage). Luckily, he clears things up before they get really awkward. Dub Name Change: Renamed "Beater Joe" in the Italian manga in order to keep the initials and make the wordplay clearer. Eyes Always Shut: He usually has his eyes closed. Family-Unfriendly Death:Justin tore his chest open and destroyed his heart, spraying blood all about the alley, and destroyed his soul for good measure.

characters.name: Enrique
characters.description: Boisterous Bruiser: It'sdifficult to tell, but Enrique is apparently quite the comedian, as his introduction had him delivering lengthy jokes (and sending Tezcatlipoca into hysterics)while Medusa was attacking him. He's also not above having a laugh at his Weapon's expense. At the same time, he's a Death Scythe meister, and will presumably end you. Improbable Weapon User: Fights wearing Tezcatlipoca, the Demon Mirror, on his ankle. The Unintelligible: He's incapable of saying anything but variations of "Gau," which is partly why he didn't show up at the initial Death Scythe convention.Intelligible Unintelligible: Although strangely, Tezca has no problems understanding him. Intelligible Unintelligible: Although strangely, Tezca has no problems understanding him.

characters.name: Fyodor
characters.description: Dance Battler: Specifically,cossack dancing. Improbable Weapon User: Pushka himself appears to be a giant iron ball on a stick; Fyodor fights by attaching the stick to one leg and launching the ball with the other. Meaningful Name: His name references Tsar Fyodor Ivanovich, who in real life commissioned the Tsar Pushka (which shares its name with Fyodor's Death Scythe). No Body Left Behind: As hinted by Maka's Soul Perception and confirmed by Crona's recount of the aftermath,Fyodor's body is broken down by Crona's Mad Blood until only his soul remains trapped in a Black Blood sphere.

characters.name: Hemming
characters.description: Meaningful Name: His name comes from American author Ernest Hemingway, who was also a hunter (and perhaps more relevant, wroteThe Old Man and the Sea). Student–Master Team: With Ahab. Young Gun: Who rides a literal "Old Gun."

characters.name: Zubaidah
characters.description: Meaningful Name: Her name is most-likely a nod toZubaidah bint Ja'far, the Abbasid princess who is featured heavily inOne Thousand and One Nights.

characters.name: Alexander
characters.description: Calling Your Attacks: "RAINBOOOW!" Facial Markings: A large white spot on his face.

characters.name: Maka's Mother
characters.description: Battle Couple: She was this with Spirit in the past, being a romantically-involved Meister and Weapon that even got married and had a daughter. Unfortunately, Spirit's playboy attitude proved too much for her to accept and she separated from him, with the divorce finalizing some time before the series picks up. The Ghost: Never appears in the story in either the manga or anime. The closest she has to an onscreen appearance is when she sends Maka a certain postcard in the anime.She would finally physically appear in the final scene ofFire Force. Small Role, Big Impact: Despite never appearing, it's heavily implied that the reason why Maka decided to pursue her current life as a scythe meister was to follow in her mother's footsteps. Superior Successor: Zig-Zagged when it comes to being Spirit's Meister compared to his first one Stein. While she was the one who actually made Spirit a Death Scythe, Spirit admits that Stein is a far superior Meister even with how much he holds her in respect. On the other hand, they had a far more stable partnership even disregarding Stein's constant experiments on Spirit in his sleep. Unseen No More:She finally appears on the very last page ofFire Force. And sure enough,she's a dead-ringer for her daughter.

characters.name: Spartoi in General
characters.description: Always in Class One: No coincidence all members of Spartoi are classmates from Class Crescent Moon. Ascended Extra: Team Kilik, mainly the meisters. Ox, Kilik, and Kim are all more or less introduced as background characters, but as the story goes on all of them slowly get much more in the way of characterization and plot relevance. Badass Crew: A group of elite E.A.T. students selected to face Witches and evil masterminds. The Cameo:Younger versions of Maka, Soul, Kid and Black☆Star appear in the epilogue chapter ofFire Force. Color Motifs: White and blue are the two colors of choice for Spartoi uniforms.Blue is pretty obvious why, white may be a reference to Death's mask.

characters.name: Maka Albarn
characters.description: Badass Bookwormand meister to Soul. Her goal is to obtain the 100 souls required to turn Soul into a Death Scythe. She tries to be a kind, mature, and responsible girl with her desire to be a model student and following her mother's path, however she does have aHot-Bloodedstreak and something of a short fuse. The Ace: Played with. Even if Maka isn't as physically powerful as Kid or Star, it's repeatedly noted by other characters that Maka's Soul Perception abilities and usage of the Anti-Demon wavelength are pretty much extraordinary,to the point that she can cancel out the onset of Madness even when facing Asura himself head-on. Despite all that, Maka has a rather low opinion of herself and is riddled with feelings of inferiority toward her peers. However, for as much as she compares herself negatively towards them, her friendssee Maka's talents for what they are, openly admitting that she and Soul are capable of things that the rest of them aren't. Action Girl: She's always ready to throw down when her friends need her. She's only a teenage girl, but fights and defeats monsters, witches, and evil forces with a huge badass scythe.And all while wearing a miniskirt. A-Cup Angst: She has a flat figure, and tends to be upset when this is pointed out. She's also often jealous when aroundbuxom womenlike Blair. This anxiety is somewhat played-up in the manga. Adaptational Jerkass: Downplayed. The anime and other supplementary materials such as the dramaCDsoften played up her tendency to dish out herMaka Chopwilly nilly and just made her a lot crankier in general.

characters.name: Soul "Eater" Evans
characters.description: Maka's snarky Demon Scythe partner, who constantly strives to be a "cool" guy, with mixed success. He's also a talented pianist, but suffers some resentment towards his more gifted violinist brother, Wes. Achey Scars: In the manga, his scar from Ragnarok aches as Medusa experiments with Crona's black blood more and more. Adaptational Personality Change: Downplayed, he is relatively calmer in the manga compared to the anime. The anime has him be a bit more quirkier and in certain parts,a little less intelligent, anda little more belligerent.A lesser case also happens with his general attitude towards sexy women. In the manga, Soul is aCelibate Herowho never actually actively seeks women, the only 2 cases where he brought up the topic was to mess withMaka, but otherwise his nosebleed problems were caused by Blairactively harassing himand not because he purposely brought it to himself, and he was also consistently annoyed by it. In other materials such as the dramaCDs, Soul is often portrayed to be a bit more perverted. A lesser case also happens with his general attitude towards sexy women. In the manga, Soul is aCelibate Herowho never actually actively seeks women, the only 2 cases where he brought up the topic was to mess withMaka, but otherwise his nosebleed problems were caused by Blairactively harassing himand not because he purposely brought it to himself, and he was also consistently annoyed by it. In other materials such as the dramaCDs, Soul is often portrayed to be a bit more perverted. Adaptational Ugliness: Downplayed. Soul in the manga had always had softer and cuter features compared to the anime, where his design was made to look more akin to that of Gorillaz's 2D in the beginning. It takes him to undergo his post-kishin revival wardrobe change for his design in the anime to look closer to how he was drawn in the manga, being overall more conventionally attractive.

characters.name: Black☆Star
characters.description: A loud-mouthed ninja who doesn't seem to graspthe conceptof stealth, Black☆Star is a perpetual show-off whose stated goal in life is to surpass God. He is Tsubaki's meister. He is largely theAnti-Heroof the primary main characters. The Ace: Frequently lampshaded. For as big of an ego as Black☆Star has, he'smorethan capable of backing up his boasts with feats of superhuman strength time and time again.In the final arc, Star is able to lift up one of the moon's teeth, to the absolute bafflement of both Maka and Kid. In terms of raw physical power, Black☆Star iseasilythe strongest of the trio. Achievements in Ignorance: Much of what he can do comes from the fact that he literally refuses to accept he can't. Stein even trains him with this in mind. Almighty Janitor: After the Book of Eibon arc, Death the Kid hails Black☆Star as the strongest meister in DWMA, and yet Black☆Star is far from promoting Tsubaki to a Death Scythe or be recognized by the masses that he indeed is the strongest. Ambition Is Evil: Played with. His ambitious desire to surpass the gods originally set him on the path towards becoming a Kishin. This trait has been remarked upon by more than one character, but he instead changes his ambition towards helping allies instead of for personal glory.

characters.name: Tsubaki Nakatsukasa
characters.description: Black☆Star's agreeable and level-headed Dark Demon Blade partner. She can change into multiple ninja weapons (shuriken, smoke bomb, a katana, etc). Action Girl: Easily the most kick ass of the female weapons. Badass Adorable: Tsubaki is a competent partner and weapon, but her friendly nature and kindness as well as being theOnly Sane Womanat times, makes her very cute. Bathing Beauty: Time delay before her first bath? One episode. Beware the Nice Ones: She's usually kind and humble. Thus, when she finally and truly stands up for herself in the fight against her brother, the result was pure awesome.

characters.name: Death the Kid
characters.description: Son of the Grim Reaper and meister to Liz and Patty. He is a very gifted meister whose only flaw is his crippling OCD, which manifests as an obsessive need to have everything be symmetrical. Hence, his naturally asymmetrical hairstyle is a source of great angst for him. Ain't Too Proud to Beg:Gets on his hands and knees and begs the witches' council to aid the DWMA in destroying Asura, right after reminding them that he can kill every one of them without any trouble. Almighty Janitor: Perhaps the only one of the three main teams to still count as this.Black☆Star and Maka are promoted to two-star students whereas Kid, thanks to having been kidnapped by a magician, is still where he started. Though for him it always has been more of a technicality, since being Death's family trumps his status as a one-star Meister. Of course, he eventually outgrows this whenhe becomes the new Grim Reaper. Artificial Human:Kid is more accurately theAnthropomorphic Personficationof Death's "order", being his second attempt at creating a child after Asura. As such, he doesn't have a mother, nor was he traditionally "born". TheStealth PrequelFire Forceactually established that when Kid was created, he already looked like a toddler and was wearing his signature suit. Awesome Moment of Crowning:In the final chapter, where is crowned as the new Grim Reaper in wake of his father's death.

characters.name: Patricia "Patty" Thompson
characters.description: One of Kid's Double Team Demon Guns and the younger of the Thompson sisters. Her personality yo-yos between childishCloud Cuckoo Landerand insanely grinning badass, typically acting as the meister for her sister when Kid isn't available. Originally hails from Brooklyn. Action Girl: She is not only capable of wielding her sister in gun-form as well, but is a very capable physical fighter. Attention Deficit... Ooh, Shiny!: As part of herGenki Girlpersonality. Ax-Crazy: There's been several hints that she can be one vicious girl underneath the goofy personality.She was apparently much worse before meeting Kid. Badass Adorable: She certainly looks younger than she is, bust-size aside, and acts like a hyperactive child, but she's not one of the Grim Reaper's heir's partners for nothing.

characters.name: Elizabeth "Liz" Thompson
characters.description: Kid's other Demon Gun and the older Thompson sister. She is the more laid-back member of their trio and often expresses chagrin at her teammates' wackiness. She originally hails from Brooklyn. Action Girl: As par for Spartoi, though not as much as her sister. A-Cup Angst: While she isn't flat or as small as Maka, she is greatly upset at the fact that her younger sister has a significantly larger breast size than her (it annoys Kid as well since it makes them asymmetrical to each other). The Bully: Shown to be this alongside Patty inSoul Eater Not!, which takes place before the main series, where she deliberately starts a fight with the protagonists just for looking at her funny. Thankfully, it's also the start of herCharacter Developmentto the Patty and Liz we know and love now. Cloudcuckoolander's Minder: She tries to be the voice of reason whenever Kid gets too fixated in his ridiculous obsession with symmetry.

characters.name: Ox Ford
characters.description: Adrenaline Makeover: After joining Spartoi, Ox grows his hair out and swaps his glasses for goggles. Anime Hair: He uses a lot of hair gel to keep it that way. Badass Bookworm: Pretty much describes himself as such. In a couple occasions where he'sshirtlesswe see he's much more muscular than you'd expect. Dogged Nice Guy: To Kim.It all pays off in the end when he proves he really will stand by her no matter what, even if she's a Witch. Expository Hairstyle Change: He grows his hair out, though he keeps his "pillars", after Spartoi is formed.Right before the next time he actuallyfightshe shaves it again, which annoys Kim because she told him to grow it out in the first place.

characters.name: Harvar D. Eclair
characters.description: Blade Below the Shoulder: When in partial weapon state. Cool Shades: In contrast to Ox's spectacles, Harvar wears these no matter what. His first pair obscured his eyes, his second does not at all. Cutting the Knot: His solutions to most problems are precise displays of violence.He stabs the brainwashed Kim in the gut with intent to kill which she only recovers from via her healing magic, he grabs the brainwashed Jackie by the neck from behind and shocks her unconscious when she tries to attack OxandKim who just threw off the brainwashing, and he quickly kills the Arachnophobia minion that was distracting Pot of Fire and Pot of Thunder with a stab through the head. Early Installment Character-Design Difference: When he first appeared in the manga, he lacked his ponytail and instead had a bowl cut. Since he only appeared in his human form briefly during this appearance, it can be hard to recall. The animeavertsthis by giving him his normal look during that appearance. I Am Not Left-Handed: Most weapons don't show terribly strong individual combat capabilities. Harvar, on the other hand, proves otherwise. Out of all the weapons, he fights most effectively on his own, and easily held offboth Jackie and Kimon his own.

characters.name: Kilik Lunge
characters.description: Badass and Child Duo: The "Children" are his child partners. Kilik is the "Badass." How so?Figured out how to use FOUR weapons together (Liz, Patty, Pot of Fire, and Pot of Thunder) to create aWave-Motion Guneffect. Still not convinced? In his debut chapter, he's billed as one of the three strongest one-star Miesters (at the time), alongside Kid and Black☆Star. Big Damn Heroes:In chapter 111, right when it seems like Asura has won, Kilik and Azusa shoot Asura in the head all the way from Earth with some handy calculations from Eruka. It ends up being just the distraction that the heroes needed to turn the tables on Asura. Dub Name Change: The original manga apparently holds his name as "Kirikou Rung" with Kilik Lung being what the dub calls him. Hot-Blooded: He can be quite heated and passionate in battle, not unlike Black☆Star. Improbable Weapon User: He fights using twinpots.

characters.name: Pot of Fire and Pot of Thunder
characters.description: Ambiguous Gender: At first it's difficult to tell if they're identical female or male twins, or simply fraternal twins. A poweruptemporarily causes them to grow older, showing that Fire is a boy, and Thunder is a girl. Ambiguously Brown: They are dark-skinned, but also sport blond hair and blue eyes. Noteworthy in that while other characters' ethnicities are made explicit (Tsubaki is Japanese, Kilik is black, etc.), the Pots' is left up in the air. Badass Adorable: Considering how they're toddlers and through ALL the freaky, scary stuff they've been through, and they haven't shown any signs of fear, they are DEFINITELY badass. Blush Sticker: The Pots almost always have them visible on their cheeks, even in the middle of battle. It highlights their childish appearance. Cute Mute: Neither of them speak at any point in the series, and are two young, cute children.

characters.name: Kimial "Kim" Diehl
characters.description: All of the Other Reindeer:She can't kill people with her magical power and was cast out from the witches because of it. Ambadassador:Kid assigns her to be the diplomat between the DWMA and the Witches at the end of the manga, with Ox Ford helping her. Animal Motifs: Thetanuki(raccoon-dog).It's her motif as a Witch. Brainwashed and Crazy:Arachne realized all too well she was a good witch and has her and Jacqueline brainwashed to turn her evil. Ox Ford manages to snap her out of it. Color-Coded Eyes: Kim's eyes are green, noteworthy in that she tends to be a bit greedy, often demanding payment for even the smallest of services.

characters.name: Jacqueline O. Lantern Dupré
characters.description: Brainwashed and Crazy:When she and Kim join Arachne, though it takes a while to snap her out of the effects. Curiously, while Kim acts out of character to Ox whilst under the effects of the insanity machine, Jackie's dedication to her meister remains. Curtains Match the Window: Her hair and eyes are both dark. Epic Flail: When she's notPlaying with Fireor makingstuff blow up. Fire-Breathing Weapon:: Jacqueline's weapon form is a lantern capable of blasting fire. Flying Broomstick: Not a broomstick, but she can extend a pole out of her weapon form to let Kim ride her like one.An early hint as to Kim's true nature

characters.name: In General
characters.description: Always Chaotic Evil: Witches, with few exceptions, are considered by DWMA to be this due to the "SwayofMagic", which leads them towards destruction by nature. However, witches themselves consider it a part of aPropaganda Machinethat justifies DWMA hunting them, and the only really evil witches seen (outside of Samantha) have been the Gorgon Sisters, who are considered renegades even among witches.It's ultimately deconstructed in the end — although witches are inherently drawn towards destruction, the story highlights that said destruction doesn't necessarily need to beevil, opening the door for the witches and the DWMA to finally put an end to their centuries-long battle. Animal Motifs: They have animal motifs in their names, appearances, and powers:Mabaa's seems to be crows. The courthouse was full of them (including a giant bird skeleton in a bowl), and her sleeves make her arms look like wings.Foxes for the Witch Judge.Medusa has a snake motif. Her vector arrows resemble snakes, and much of her magic takes the form of snakes. Her chant is also "snake snake, cobra cobra."Arachne's motif is spiders and her magic takes the form of them, while she is often seen sitting in a web high above the ground.Eruka, for frogs. Her magic takes the form of frog-shaped bombs, she croaks as aVerbal Tic, and she can take on the shape of a frog. Her familiar seems to be a giant tadpole.Mizune, for mice. The Mizune sisters speak in mouselike squeaking, sport mouse ears, and have mouse-themed spells. Their fused form also has a tattoo on her stomach resembling mouse whiskers.Angela, for chameleons. Her last name is quite literally "chameleon" and her hat resembles a chameleon with a long tongue as a decorative ribbon.Kim, for raccoon-dogs.ShaulafromSoul Eater Not!, for ScorpionsLisa and Arisa (the witches-in-hiding who run Chupa Cabra's), have butterfly and firefly for their themes.Blair subverts this by not actually being a witch, so rather than being a cat-themed magical witch, she'

characters.name: Mabaa
characters.description: The Archmage: She is the ruler of the witches' realm. Asskicking Leads to Leadership: She is a witch who is almost on par with Death, and is considered the leader of her race. Barrier Maiden: Uses her magic to warp an unknown area so witches can have a haven to reside in and hide from the DWMA. Big Damn Heroes:She uses her magic to save Spirit, Sid, and Marie from getting sealed on the moon in the manga's last chapter. Eyepatch of Power: Wears one with 1/2 written on it. Covers the socket of the eye that Free took from her.

characters.name: Witch Judge
characters.description: An elder witch and Mabaa's assistant. Court Mage: She’s Mabaa’s right-hand and a witch. Hanging Judge: If the name wasn't a dead giveaway, she is completely unreasonable. In fact, she was the main reasonKim was cast out witch society in the first place because she didn't have any destructive magic. Honor Before Reason: Or possiblyrevengefrom a certain point of view, she practically refuses Kid's plea for help against Asura despite him actually getting to his knees and groveling andKimlikewise doing the same, not to mention the danger Asura possesses for everyone on the planet. Thankfully Mabaa was more than willing to cooperate much to the Witch Judge's chagrin. Moral Myopia: She believes humans are monsters for hunting witch souls to complete a Death Scythe. While it's possible she may have a point (considering that Angela and, to an extent, Blair who aren't evil yet were hunted), a good number of witches that were seen in the series weren't exactly moral and sought to bring harm. Also rather hypocritical of her as well in regards toKim who's healing magic could've actually proven quite useful to the witches. Yet she cast Kim out of the society because her magic had no offensive capabilities, leaving Kim to fend for herself and knowing she could be killed for her soul if she was found out (i.e.:helpingthe enemy). For all her talk of hating Lord Death, it says something that he was at least more reasonable and accommodating toward Kim.

characters.name: Medusa Gorgon
characters.description: One of the series' central antagonists, Medusa is a centuries-oldMad Scientistwho wants to tear down the old world lead by Death and build a new world in its place. She is the younger sister of Arachne and the mother of Crona, who is one of the main targets of Medusa's cruelty and experiments. Her magical theme is snakes. Abusive Mom: Sheused her child Crona as a lab rat, injecting them with madness-inducing black blood and forcing them to butcher animals or be locked in a sensory deprivation room without food or water for days as part of the "experiment." Action Mom: A villainous example. She is Crona's mother and is a very deadly fighter, as well as being the series'Big Bad. Anti-Escape Mechanism: Can use her Vector Plates to trap her opponents. Prominently, she formed a circle of these around her and Stein in their first battle. Arch-Enemy: To Maka. Besides just the obvious conflict of being on opposing sides of good and evil, Medusa's abusive control over Crona has earned her Maka's hatred. Part of the reason for Maka's determination to take her down is to get payback for everything she's done to Crona.

characters.name: Arachne Gorgon
characters.description: The secondBig BadinSoul Eater, Medusa's older sister, and a powerful witch. She is the leader of the massive Organization "Arachnophobia" and is referred to as the mother of all Demon Weapons. Her magical theme is spiders. Arachnid Appearance and Attire: Arachne, meaning spider in Greek, is nicknamed the "Spider Witch" and the "Spider Queen". She's anEerie Pale-Skinned Brunetteof tall height with an hourglass figure and long, thin limbs. She wears her hair in a bun that ends in the shape of a spider's pedipalps. She has web patterns on her irises, the collar of her black dress, and her hand fan. Arc Villainess: For the combined Brew Island/Capture Baba Yaga's Castle arcs. Assimilation Plot:In the manga, Arachne's ultimate goal is to shed her physical body and become madness itself, uniting all people in insanity (and the feeling of their brains being eaten by spiders). Astonishingly Appropriate Appearance: She looks exactly like one would expect a witch named "Arachne" to look- like a spider given human form.

characters.name: Shaula Gorgon
characters.description: Ambition Is Evil: Her drive to be the superior of the Gorgon sisters and crushing the DWMA. Big Bad Wannabe: Seeks to prove herself as being superior to Medusa and Arachne but getskilled by non-Spartoi students, showing she never had a hope of matching up to either of her sisters. Exotic Eye Designs: She has yin-yang shaped eyes. The Faceless: Her face didn't appear in the anime until episode 5. Freudian Excuse: In the anime, she states that she'slooking to make the DWMA feel the same despair and loneliness that she has experienced because of their persecution of witches.

characters.name: Crona
characters.description: Crona is Ragnarok's meister ofintentionally unclear gender, and initially worked for Medusa due to being aTyke-Bomb. Crona is unusual for a meister because they and Ragnarok share the same body, which is a source ofSquickfor the heroes. Crona alternated between being homicidally insane and fearful when under Medusa, later showing a nicer side when at the DWMA. Adaptational Heroism: Due to the anime ending much before the manga and diverging from its storyline, Crona ends firmly on the side of the DWMA by the end of it, rather than going through majorSanity Slippageandfusing with Asura. Adaptation Dye-Job: Their hair was pink in the manga but purple in the anime (though there are a few manga illustrations where it's purple, it's usually pink). Ambiguous Gender: Crona's gender is unspecified and characters very rarely bring it up, but they don't seem to know either. Patty asked her sister Crona's gender, but we don't see any response. Much later, Black Star fights Crona and claims to match their three swords by counting his penis as a "sword", but realizes that logic means Cronamighthave a fourth sword. The author has refused to answer it as well. Ambiguous Innocence:In the penultimate chapter, they confessed to Maka to not understand what was wrong with their actions. Which, to be clear, had included killing people and eating their souls and trying to destroy the world. Despite this, they decide to save the world simply to make Maka happy.

characters.name: Ragnarok
characters.description: Ragnarok is Crona's Demon Sword partner. He shares a body with his meister and loves to bully and torment them at every opportunity. Aw, Look! They Really Do Love Each Other: In the animewhen Crona jumps in front of Medusa's vector attack to save Maka, Ragnarok comes out of the resulting pool of blood saying that they're both going to die and it's all Maka's fault, "but at least stupid Crona isn't alone in the end." Bizarre Taste in Food: He likes pepper in his coffee. Black Swords Are Better: His Weapon form is a black broadsword in its initial appearance, though he takes a much thinner form after beingBrought Down to Normal. After being powered back up and fusing with the Black Clown, he gains the ability to manifest asthreeswords (The Abyss of Despair, The Uncleaniness, and The Darkness), two of which he wields himself via Black Blood arms while Crona wields the remaining one. Bloody Murder: He's Crona'sEquippable Allymade out ofBlack Blood, after all.

characters.name: Eruka Frog
characters.description: Anti-Villain: She doesn't want much of anything to do with Medusa, but isn't free to act on her own. Berserk Button: She gets rather upset when anyone does something to her pet/familiar Tadpole Jackson. Butt-Monkey:Since losing to Medusa, she's been subject to quite a lot of humiliation and physical abuse (like Medusa ordering her to turn into a frog so she can step on her, or Black Star threatening toeather), basically all of which is played for laughs. Crouching Moron, Hidden Badass: Tends to be theButt-Monkeyin a given fight (to be fair, a given fight in Soul Eater is rather insane), ducking and covering before maybe doing something ratheruseful. Place her in a support role with her magic calculation, however, and she becomesfarmore powerful.In chapter 111, she ends up calculating coordinates for Kilik and Azusa to snipe Asuraall the way on the moon, which is every bit as insane as it sounds. Cute Witch: She's not as sexualized as Medusa or Blair, but is still conventionally attractive.

characters.name: Free
characters.description: An immortal werewolf placed in jail for taking Mabaa's left eye. Despite being so dangerous and powerful, his personality is quite silly. He can also be serious and cunning when needed, but he usually isn't since he can't die. Affably Evil: One gets the idea that he's more "dangerously silly" than "maliciously evil" because he's a friendly guy when he's not beating you up or releasing monsters. Barefoot Captives: He has no shoes in his prison attire and remains so through the series. Breath Weapon: His Magic Eye Cannon (despite the name) has him firing a huge laser from his mouth. It's called "Magic Eye" because the energy takes the form of an glowing eye before he fires it. Catchphrase: He's got at least two: the chant "Wolf, wolves, wolf, wolves," and the more informal"GODDAMNSHIIIIT!"

characters.name: Mizune
characters.description: Adorable Evil Minions: The individual Mizune have the appearance of mouse-like children, despite apparently all being adult. Avenging the Villain: The five sisters assist Medusa because she's the witch most actively threatening the DWMA, who Eruka said killed the sixth sister for no reason but being a witch. What they don't know is they're helping the actual culprit.After Medusa is killed and Eruka released, she presumably told them the truth and the Mizune sisters on board with the truce. Bishōnen Line: They're individually small, strange, mice-like women, but can merge together to increase their power while looking progressively more like a sexy lady. Played with in that their five-member form ispresumablythe strongest, but never uses any magic on-screen, and is only formed once simply to show off her body. Cat Fight: They get a literal one against Blair.With an all-male audience watching, of course. Flight: Unlike other witches who use brooms, the Mizune can fly with their own power. Said power makes it look like they have rocket engines under their dresses.

characters.name: Giriko
characters.description: Giriko is a Demon Weapon and an ally to the witch Arachne, having endured 800 years of life for the chance to serve her once she returns from her hidden state. He lives for fighting and destruction, and takes the form of a chainsaw in weapon form. Actually a Doombot: When he fights Maka and Soul in the Book of Eibon, the pair seem to have triumphed and killed him.And then he shows up in a female body, explaining the body the pair killed was a golem and he had transferred his mind to a new one awhile ago. Adaptational Nice Guy: While he's still a villain, he's nowhere near as bad of one in the anime adaptation, which omitted his more depraved acts such as molesting Maka, trying to rape Maka with a chainsaw, and stealing the bodies of his descendants for effective immortality. Armed Legs: His favorite method of fighting is to run sawblades along his legs and kick with them. He can also use them as makeshift treads to move around quicker. Assist Character: Giriko is aShapeshifter Weaponwho's found a way around his dependence on a meister by letting himself be used as anEquippable Allyby aGolemhe created which is animated by Arachne's soul.

characters.name: Mosquito
characters.description: Mosquito is Arachne's butler. His appearance is a short old man with a large pointy nose which is used to suck the blood out of a victim. Animal Motifs: The mosquito of course, save for his form from 400 years ago where he was represented by bats. Bad Boss: One mook makes the unfortunate mistake of being a loyal servant and checking if Mosquito is okay following a fight with some DWMA students. Mosquito does not hesitate to use his nose to stab and drain the poor guy of his blood.Ouch. Beard of Evil: He has a handlebar moustache that ends in sharp points. Big Ol' Unibrow: It's hidden under his hat most the timebut it's there.

characters.name: Mifune
characters.description: A samurai with a soul so strong that it counts for ninety-nine souls by itself. Black Star was about to take his soul but stopped when he saw how Mifune was protecting the young witch, Angela. He acts like a big brother or even a father to Angela. Once Arachnophobia is reformed Mifune starts working for them in exchange for protection for Angela. Adaptation Dye-Job: Acolor spreadin the manga depicts him as golden-blond. The anime instead gives hima pale brownof some sort. Anti-Villain: Though he did join Arachnophobia, slaughter more than a dozen DWMA military staff, and serve as a warrior-for-hire by crime families in the past, his soul is still displayed with a blue "good" hue and he only seeks to protect Angela from the DWMA witch persecutions. Badass and Child Duo: The badass to Angela's child. Badass Normal: When you consider that he isn't a Meister or Weapon, his feats are even more impressive. Not only does he handBlack Starhis ass often (only losing their first fight because he held back and underestimated Black Star at a crucial moment), but has fought on even footing with Sid, who was using a Death Scythe. Death notes that Mifune is a rare "strong soul" that's worth the equivalent of 99 souls on his own.

characters.name: Fisher King
characters.description: One of Arachnophobia's assassins, a rather ditzy evil human who wears an equally odd orange deep-sea diving suit. He is sent to take the Eternal Spring from the Runaway Express, and fights Kid over it with his hook firing cannon. Abnormal Ammo: He wields a hook-firing cannon. Ambiguously Human: If you didn't know he was an evil human you'd probably assume this. His body moves in such a way that one could think he was a balloon monster.his whole body even looks like it deflated when he dies by Sid's hand, despite being shot in the abdomen a little while earlier by Kid and still moving that way. Assassin Outclassin': He's distinctly referred to as an assassin by Kid, but seems to be anInformed Attribute, as he's only sent to get the Eternal Spring and is never shown hunting somebody down. Blood from Every Orifice:After he is killed by Sid, blood is seen coming out of an eyehole of his mask, since this eyehole is facing up, its unlikely that it is runoff from his forehead (where he got stabbed with the knife).

characters.name: Risa and Arisa
characters.description: Adaptational Heroism: They're only witches in the manga. If they are in the anime, it is never revealed since the story never dwells on the other witches outside the Gorgon Sisters, though they are seen helping Joe along with Blair. Chekhov's Gunman: In the mangathey're freed to help save Kid from the Book of Eibon. The Mole: They try to spy on the DWMA through Spirit, but their efforts are always fruitless because all he ever talks about is his family. If anything, it made DWMA more suspicious of them and eventually outed them out in the end. Stepford Smiler: Averted. They smile because it's their job to be friendly. Stripperiffic: Theydowork in a cabaret club.

characters.name: Angela Leon
characters.description: Badass and Child Duo: The Child to Mifune's badass. Bratty Half-Pint: To basically everyone but Mifune, especially Black Star. In particular, she seems to findhitting people in the ballsvery fun. Children Are Innocent: Unusual, considering thenature of witches. Supposedly, all of them start out innocent, but their magic makes them prone toward destruction (with the exception of one other witch). Cute Witch: Angela is still a child and so is cute unlike the antagonisticHot Witches. Meaningful Name:AngelaLeonis a good witch with a chameleon motif.

characters.name: Blair
characters.description: Not actually a witch, Blair is just a cat with strong magical powers. When in human form, she's aHot Witchand often flirts with Soul in order to fluster him, much to Maka's irritation. Still, however, there's much more to her than she lets on and is a consistent enigma in the series. Blair's magical theme is pumpkins. Accidental Hero: During the Kishin arc, Blair halts the Mizune sister's diversionary attack on Death City because they got too close to hurting her, then further wastes their time by arguing over who has the better body. Aloof Ally: She doesn't work for the DWMA, but sometimes comes along and fights alongside her roommates, apparently just to kill the time. Attractive Bent-Gender: When the Lust chapter of the Book of Eibon switches everyone's gender, Blair becomes a man handsome enough to distract asuccubus. Back from the Dead: Dies in her first encounter against Maka and Soul. Then promptly shows back up, much to the pair's confusion.Since she's a cat, she has nine lives.

characters.name: Samantha
characters.description: A Necromancer Witch, she is the target of Death the Kid's mission to Egypt's Pyramid of Anubis for using her magic to ensnare wandering souls to make mummies and attack innocent people with them. Bait-and-Switch Boss: Set up to be Kid's main opponent of his introduction chapter/episode after Master Thief Lupin ran off, only to be violently replaced by his actual opponent, the Wrath of the Pharaoh. Evil Is Not a Toy: She intends to resurrect the Pharaoh as a powerful mummy under her control, only to learn too late he's both too strong for her to control and none too pleased about her controlling his subjects before gettingEaten Alivefor it. Gonk: Compared to most Witches who are either sexy or at least cute-looking, Samantha looks like a wrinkly toad with bulging eyes. Necromancer: Her explicit title is "Necromancer Witch", with her specialty including capturing souls to create mummies or bring the dead back to life.

characters.name: Excalibur
characters.description: The legendary sword used by heroes and kings. In spite of his immense powers, Excalibur hardly ever has a meister because no one can put up with his unbearably grating, loudmouthed, egomaniac personality. He usually resides in a cave full of fairies, who also can't stand him.Fire Forcereveals his origins. Absurdly Sharp Blade: Can cut through Dimensions; justonereason why he's called THE most powerful weapon in the setting. Awesome, but Impractical: He isthemost powerful weapon in the setting. He can synchronize his soul wavelength with anyone, but he's so immensely annoying that almost no one can stand being near him. Brick Joke: In one of the tales about his past, he managed to getWatsonarrested. Later, when watching a Sherlock Holmes movie, heagainaccuses Watson of being guilty. Watson,on screen, panics after being accused. Captain Ersatz: Excalibur's character design comes straight out ofThe Moomins.

characters.name: Kishin Asura
characters.description: The strongest and most dangerous antagonist inSoul Eater, as well as theGreater-Scope Villainfor the entire series and the first demon god. He was supposedly once human, a meister and Death's apprentice who ate his own weapon partner after going insane with fear. Before the start of the series, he was defeated by Shinigami-sama andimprisoned. However he is eventually released and begins to spread "madness" throughout the world. Adaptational Wimp: The anime version is considerably much weaker than in the manga.In the anime, Maka, Black Star and Death The Kid put a good fight and he was defeated by Maka, even after he already managed to defeat Shinigami and consume Arachne's soul. In the manga, even after Soul became a Death Scythe, Black Star wentBeyond the Impossibleto become a god-like fighter, Maka controlled the Black Blood and wielded her Death Scythe father, and Kid ascended as the new Lord Death, they could not defeat Asura and Crona knew, sincehe will exist as long fear exists, the only way they could defeat him wasto seal him in the moon... for a while. Also, because the anime ended beforeThe Revealof Asura's true nature, he went from a Great Old One who embodies humanity's fear and Death's eldest son evenbeforehe became a Kishin to "just" an exceptionally powerful Meister before his Kishin ascension. And Then What?: Subverted in the anime.Excaliburasks him what he intends to do after filling the world with his madness. Asura replies that madness is enough for the world. Antagonistic Offspring:He is Death's firstborn "son" and Death the Kid's older brother, created by Death removing his fears from his person and incarnating them into a separate being. While he did serve his father as a powerful subordinate for a time, ultimately the very emotions of fear and paranoia that made up the core of his being proved too much for him to overcome andhe shut out anyone who could have helped him, eventually turning to devouring souls for more power and sating his parano

characters.name: Eibon
characters.description: The mysterious creator of BREW, the Eternal Spring, and the Book of Eibon, among other demon tools. Eibon was one of Shinigami's eight warriors, alongside Asura. Not much else is known about him. Anthropomorphic Personification: Represents the madness of knowledge. The Atoner: Anime only.He sided with Arachne to save his lover from death, and turns himself into the key to unlock BREW for Shinigami to use when he failed. Eldritch Abomination:Called a Great Old One, along with the other Eight Warlords. The Engineer: Creator of the Demon Tools (Magic Tools in the English anime dub), which all take the some form of mechanical object.

characters.name: The Great Old One of Power
characters.description: Ambiguous Gender: It's a massive, inky black mass, and onlyveryvaguely humanoid. So it seems safe to say thatAtshushiis justified in this case. Anthropomorphic Personification: Represents the madness of power, hence its title. Cthulhumanoid: Even though the it barely looks human, its face sort of resembles Cthulhu's, probably done to emphasize its status as anEldritch Abomination. Domain Holder: It controls its own section of the Book of Eibon and can choose who enters or leaves at a whim. Eldritch Abomination: See foryourself◊. Also, see what it calls itself.

characters.name: Noah
characters.description: Seemingly the thirdBig Badof the series, Noah originally appeared to work for Arachne in helping develop various Demon Tools, until it's revealed that his true goal is to use the Book of Eibon to absorb and "collect" everything, which he feels in essence would make him "everything". Ambiguously Brown:And apparently no biological heritage to speak of. Artificial Human:After he gets killed, the "Table Of Contents" in the Book of Eibon reveals he was a manifestation of the Greed chapter, called a "statue." Another one is sent out, this time of the Wrath chapter. Battle Trophy: After killing Mosquito, he picks up the corpse of one of the bloodsucker's bats that remained behind and decides to keep it as a souvenir. Big Creepy-Crawlies: His personal magic revolves around caterpillars and centipedes. OnNightmare Fuel.

characters.name: Gopher
characters.description: A fanatical servant of Noah. Gopher has a rather aggressive and violent nature, especially if it is concerning insults made towards Noah, whom he is both extremely protective over and obsessed about. Gopher personally believes that he is the only one who can satisfy Noah. Justin also describes Gopher as always being uptight. He later demonstrates a tendency to bite his top lip whenever he becomes enraged. Air Jousting: His fight with Maka turns into a high-flying, high-speed chase through the sky where she and Soul have to figure out aerial combat and master her Grigori soul to stand a chance against Gopher's speed and projectile spam. Artificial Human: Based on several lines, such as Noah noting he's a guinea pig, Maka noting his soul seems strange and altered, and Gopher being angry Maka managed to damage him by saying his body was a gift from "Noah-sama", Gopher is either a sentient Demon Tool created by Noah or a human magically augmented by him. Beneath the Mask: Initially he comes off as quiet, if not a little smug and sadistic, but that's just him trying to come off as the perfect servant to Noah. When he's riled up, he screams, makes wild facial expressions, and shouts about his "NOAH-SAMAAAAAA!" at the top of his lungs. Camp Gay: Pretty much, although he'sonly gay for Noah.

characters.name: Table of Contents (TOC)/The Index/The Directory
characters.description: Affably Evil: Its motivations certainly aren't good, but it's still polite, helpful, and true to its word. Arc Villain:It was responsible for creating the Noahs, both the first Greed incarnation who acted as the Big Bad for the Book of Eibon Arc, while The TOC was operating behind the scenes, and the second Wrath. Beyond the Impossible: Even TOC has made the "I've-meet-Excalibur" face,despite nothavinga face. Big Bad Wannabe:It wants so desperately to upstage and "collect" Asura, but it's quickly kicked out of the running by Crona's sudden appearance absorbing Asura and Noah (along with the Book) instead. Evil Knockoff: Excalibur says it was modeled after him, but unlike his, Index'sGag Noseisn't turned up. Appropriately, Index'sMr. Expositiontraits are toned down in comparison, and even it finds its model frustrating.

characters.name: The Clown
characters.description: Insanity incarnate, it was born as a result of the madness Asura released into the world. Maka and Soul first encountered it in a twisted factory where it tried to drive them both insane, but they defeated it with Maka's anti-demon wavelength. It escaped, and has since allied itself with Noah's team and with Justin Law in particular. Until they find the Kishin on the Moon and they abandon Noah for Asura's clown armies. Adaptational Heroism: The Clown and itsPalette Swappeddouble appear in the anime, but instead of having anything to do with Asura they're mechanical guardians of the key to Brew. They stilled killed quite a few innocent people, though. Combat Tentacles: White Rabbit's main weapons. The Corruption:It and the Black Clown spread insanity just by existing.In turn, the Clowns rise from the corruption of Asura's insanity.Asura's dwelling ispackedwith them. It and the Black Clown spread insanity just by existing.

characters.name: The Flying Dutchman
characters.description: The Dutchman is the soul of the ship Nidhogg, who fought Death the Kid while collecting souls for the Kishin. He later appeared as a factory which housed The Clown. Ultimately, he was destroyed, after being toyed with by Blair. Berserk Button: Becomes furious to the point of madness when Blair steals his hat. Genius Loci: A ship, and, later, a factory. Go Out with a Smile:For some reasonwhen he's tricked into making himself dissolve he looks as if he's ascending into heaven. Hand Cannon: His weapon of choice during his time on the ghost ship.

characters.name: Masamune
characters.description: A demon blade called the Uncanny Sword. Also Tsubaki's estranged older brother, he resented her for being a more gifted weapon than he. Alas, Poor Villain: Masamune is given a rather sympathetic death. In his last moments, he breaks free from the Madness and implicitly tells Tsubaki that, contrary to what her insecurities might tell her, she truly is a strong person. Bequeathed Power: In Masamune's last moments, he entrusts Tsubaki with the Uncanny Sword, confident that her inner strength will allow her to not fall victim to the bloody path that he took. Black Eyes of Crazy: Anyone he possesses gaines black sclerae. His own sclerae go black partway through his fight with his sister as well. Death Equals Redemption: It's clear that, despite the cruel and bloody path that Masamune took in life, Tsubaki still loves him and sees him as her brother. In Masamune's last moments, he was able torevert to the man he used to be, allowing Tsubaki to briefly reunite with her brother one last time. After Masamune's death, Tsubaki is shown asking Masamune for guidance on how to help Star, making it clear that she still sees him as the loving brother he used to be.

characters.name: Jack the Ripper
characters.description: A power-hungry Evil Human serial killer, Jack is the first character introduced in the series. Fights with long metal claws attached to his arms. Ambiguously Human: Jack barely resembles a human after consuming souls. Bait-and-Switch Boss: He's set up as theStarter Villainof Maka and Soul introduction chapter/episode, but they dispose of him after a quick if intense fight, revealing he's the99thEvil Human they've slain, and any importance he has goes out the window as the pair spend the rest of their introduction chapter fighting Blair in order to get what they think is the Witch Soul they need to turn Soul into a Death Scythe. Bald of Evil: Is balding, with hair on either side of his head. Body Horror: The entirety of the front of his face is stitched on, and his body is twisted due to soul consumption.

characters.name: Al Capone
characters.description: An evil human mobster leader who believes a Witch's soul will make him and his gang unstoppable. He escapes his initial encounter to go after Angela Leon. Bait-and-Switch Boss: Initially set up with his gang as the main enemy for Black Star and Tsubaki to take down in their introduction chapter/episode, but after Black Star botches the "assassination" attempt and has to retreat, Al Capone and his gang make the mistake of going up against Mifune to capture Angela Leon and are swiftly disposed of, allowing Mifune to take his place as Black Star's opponent. The Don: Of a small Evil HumanMafia.We're introduced to him and his goons chowing down on a fancy dinner of Souls. Mugging the Monster: Al Capone thinks Mifune is just some punk and would easily blown away by his thugs. By the time Black*Star and Tsubaki arrive,Al Capone and his gang have been slaughteredwith Mifune having no visible damage. Shout-Out: Not only to the actual Al Capone, but to Alcatraz Federal Prison, judged by the way his name is spelled in Japanese.

characters.name: Master Thief, Lupin
characters.description: An Evil Human who steals souls. He's encountered by Death the Kid in his first appearance, but escapes while Kid, Patty, and Liz distract each other with their bickering. The Bad Guy Wins: He gets away with a large bag of souls due to Kid's OCD and apparently has yet to be captured. Bait-and-Switch Boss:Just like Jack the Ripper and Al Capone before him, he seems to be set up as the initial opponent for Kid, Liz, and Patty's introduction chapter/episode, but he quicklygets out of dodgewhile Kid has one of his OCD episodeswithout even getting a fight scene, allowing him to survive. Kid's actual opponent comes in the form of the Pharaoh during his next mission. Villain with Good Publicity: He has his own comic book, which Black Star seems to enjoy thoroughly while working on the academy's library.

characters.name: Wrath of the Pharaoh
characters.description: An Evil Spirit within the Pyramid of Anubis brought back to life by Samantha the Necromancer Witch to serve as one of her mummy servants. He didn't like that or the fact she had been using the souls of his subjects to make her mummies, so he eats her. Calling Your Attacks: He likes to scream "Wrath of the Pharaoh" when he attacks. Covert Pervert: The Pharaoh doesn'texplicitlymention finding women attractive, but he seems a little to into wrapping up Liz and Patty in his bandages to display their bodies in suggestive poses rather than going right into eating their souls. Curse of the Pharaoh: He's outright called "Wrath of the Pharaoh", and he makes his displeasure of being disturbed and his people's souls being used by brutally murdering and eating the souls of intruders in his pyramid. Multiple Gunshot Death: He's gunned down with repeated shots from Kid having a furious breakdown over his asymmetrical form until Kid blows a massive hole through the pyramid and leaves only the Pharaoh's soul behind.

characters.name: Evil Monk Rasputin
characters.description: An evil human monk who appears briefly when Maka gets back to collecting souls after the botched first attempt of making Soul a Death Scythe. Badass Boast: Claims to be very resilient, which is immediately followed by him being cut in two. Immune to Bullets: Boasts that bullets have no effect on him, only to learn firsthand Soul is far deadlier than any mere bullet. Rasputinian Death: Despite what he's based on, he doesn't suffer this kind of fate. He does mention that not even bullets hurt him, which is not only a homage to the original Rasputin's mythical near invulnerability, but also ironic considering his real-life counterpart died easily via gunshot.

characters.name: Sonson J.
characters.description: An evil human in Florence, Italy, who carries a knife and wears a bag over his head. Killed people who went to Emerald Cove, which gets him targeted by Maka and Soul. Ax-Crazy: What little characterization he has is envy and childish whining that Demon Weapons and the Meisters who wield them get to kill as many people as they please whenever they please. This is in spite of the fact that they only kill Evil Humans who have become monsters on their path to becoming Kishin. In a Single Bound: He can jump extremely high, evidenced when he attacks Maka. Shout-Out: To Jason Voorhees, what with the Machete, the 13 on his back and the fact that he kills people who come to a cove. Small Role, Big Impact: Sonson J. was just another Evil Human on Death's hitlist in the long run, but his presence in Florence, Italy, is what leads to Maka and Soul having their first fateful encounter with Crona, Ragnarok and Medusa, resulting in Soul's infection with the Black Blood and the series' main conflict beyond the "create a Death Scythe" quest being established.

characters.name: Frey D. Sadoko
characters.description: An Evil Human that kills people by making them listen to a cursed word, which allows her to kill them in their dreams. Attacks with her long nails. She the 99th Evil Human of Maka's and Soul's second attempt to create a Death Scythe. Dream Walker: LikeFreddy Krueger, she's a serial killer that kills people in their dreams. Post-Final Boss: In a sense she's this to Maka and Soul's quest to create a Death Scythe. They've already claimed a Witch's Souldue to killing Arachnein a fight that was far more difficult and had much higher stakes that Frey could ever hope to achieve, but killing her is still a necessity to finally have the required number of Evil Human souls to actually use that Witch's Soul to finish the effort. Shout-Out: She's a combo ofFreddy KruegerandSadako Yamamura. In addition her main attack is calledNine Inch Nails. We Hardly Knew Ye: Her soul is swiftly taken by Maka and Soul as the penultimate one before the 100th one required for Soul's Death Scythe upgrade.

characters.name: Rachel Boyd
characters.description: A little girl who lives in Death City with her parents. Back for the Finale: Has a cameo in the manga's last chapter looking with her parents atthe newly reshaped moon. Bowdlerise:Her possession scene was censored a bit in the anime due to the fact Medusa does so throughOrifice Invasion.We see it clearly in the mangaand the poor girl succumbing to Medusa's control. While, in the anime, the screen cuts off the top of Rachel's head and we just see Medusa's tail wiggling up to her to give the indication of what happened. Evil Costume Switch:She wears a black dress similar to Medusa's own when possessed. Fille Fatale:Sorta, since Medusa keeps acting asThe Vampwhile in the poor little girl's body, doing so specially to drive Stein and others mad.

characters.name: Ahab
characters.description: Handicapped Badass: He's got a peg leg. Not that it stops him any. Meaningful Name: He's named after Captain Ahab ofMoby-Dick. But unlike his namesake, who hunts one particular whale out of revenge, this guy hunts onetypeof whale for the genuine threat it poses against his village, and the world for that matter. Student–Master Team: He's far older and more experienced than his meisters, and guides them during their hunts.

characters.name: Little Ogre
characters.description: An ogre in a suit that resides in Soul after he's infected by the Black Blood. Constantly tries to tempt him into tapping into the power. Adaptational Villainy:In the anime, he's more explicitly and actively malevolent and tries to take over Soul's body the more he used the Black Blood's power. In the manga, he moreso pesters Soul into continuing to embrace the madness himself and not suppress it rather than explicitly wanting to take the wheel, borderlining to being aTrickster Mentor. Brutal Honesty: Always out to point out Soul's flaws as a person, and he technically never lies. As a result,he actively forces Soul to confront his problems. The Corrupter: As he's a representation of the Black Blood inside Soul.In the anime he's much more active in being malevolent and even schemed to take over Soul's body that he even gotMakainto it. In the manga, the Ogre isn't as active in trying to forego Soul's right to choose on what to do with the madness and instead simply pesters him to not suppress the madness and deny it, and they both settled on a relationship more akin to that ofVitriolic Best Buds. It's worthy to note however, considering Ogre's seeming general apathy towards Soul'sconcernsin potentially hurting others if he ever goes too far, Ogre seems to be a potential candidate to become aToxic Friend Influenceif left unchecked. Deal with the Devil: Gives off this vibe. He even looks like a red devil.

characters.name: Wes Evans
characters.description: Soul's older brother. A known violin virtuoso whom Soul suffers a great deal of resentment from. The Ace: He's called a violin virtuoso in-universe and everyone expects his younger brother to follow his excellence. Unfortunately, Soul found this pressure to live up to him unbearable that he even seemed to develop a neurosis over it, where he even ended up developingChronic Self-Deprecationregarding his own apparently pretty decent skills just because he deemed he'd always be second best to Wes. Adapted Out: Thanks to theGecko Ending, he's completely absent in the anime and as a result we never got any explanations about Soul's seeming complex regarding his musician family there. Big Brother Bully: The illusion inside the Book of Eibon's Envy chapter turns him into this, considering the illusion seems to be a manifestation of Soul's insecurities, it basically shows that for Soul Wes is someone whose mere presence makes him feel like he's constantly flaunting hisAlways Someone Betterstatus and that he pities his younger brother's inferior state. Cool Big Bro: While we don't really see much of him in general, when we do see him outside of the Book of Eibon's illusions, he's shown to be someone who seems to be otherwise supportive of his younger brother. Gently inviting him to be with him and the others at a party and he even tells Soul that he loves his music as is when he asks him if he'd stop playing piano now that he wants to be a demon weapon.

characters.name: Killbell
characters.description: A hunchback evil human that appears exclusively in the video gameMonotone Princess. He guards a cocoon with a soul inside of it and is the second boss. He fights with a huge bell. Badass Normal: Moreso than a lot of other Evil Humans, he's not fast, but he is very skilled with that bell, attacking and defending in equal measure. In fact he's one of the few Evil Humans Maka has faced that has actually managed to hurt her. Improbable Weapon User: He wields a large copper bell to smash people with and can summon more to fall on top of people. Lantern Jaw of Justice: One that always covers one side of his mouth. MacGuffin Guardian: After being given the cocoon and told that feeding more souls into it will eventually allow him to be reborn like he wants, Killbell becomes obsessed with protecting it with his life and killing people to nourish it.

characters.name: Alone
characters.description: A werewolf from Germany who steals one of the cocoons with an evil human's soul inside it during the events ofMonotone Princess. Blow You Away: Alone's main fighting style is called "Wind Wolf Fist" and allows him to attack his opponents with air. Clipped-Wing Angel: Alone lost the immortality that a werewolf like him should possess (along with the ability to return to a human form) because he started down the path of a Kishin. Presumably he believed actually finishing his transformation into a Kishin would be a net positive, but he didn't and this results in his death. Jagged Mouth: A square shaped one, as opposed to the usual serrated version. it adds on to his skeletal appearance. Made of Iron: He doesn't have immortality like Free does because he ate an innocent soul, but he still takes a lot of concentrated effort to finally bring down.

characters.name: Nals
characters.description: An evil human Garnier who appears inMonotone Princess. Uses belts and a sword. Badass in a Nice Suit: It is rather spiffy, belts aside. Badass Normal: Similar to Killbell, and unlike other evil humans, Nals seems to have much more skill with his weapon as opposed to blunt force. He takes on Death the Kid in an almost even fight using fencing and speed to deflect his bullets and force him back a bit. Improbable Weapon User: A sword is common, using belts against opponents is not. Too Many Belts: He hasa lotwrapping around his face and right arm, and muffle his speaking.

characters.name: Gigant
characters.description: An evil human who was released when the soul cocoon retrieved from Alone hatched while Stein was studying it. It fights Black Star in the library, where it attacks by spinning and stabbing. Ambiguously Human: Theonlyreason he's considered an evil humanat allis because an evil human's soul was used to make him. Big Creepy-Crawlies: He's a huge ant creature. Implacable Man: Nearly got the better of Black Star because of its armor, strength, and reflexes. It took one of Star's most powerful attacks to actually take it down. Single-Stroke Battle: Notable in that it was impossible to take down beforehand, and it was fully protected when it happened.

characters.name: Tsugumi Harudori
characters.description: The protagonist ofSoul Eater Not!, she is a weapon from Japan who developed astrong admirationtoward Maka after their first meeting, even emulating her by putting her own hair in pigtails. Prior to the beginning of the series, she never had a chance to transform before she arrived at the DWMA, where she eventually finds that her weapon form is a Halberd. There is an issue with her transformation, however. While she is capable of completely transforming her body many note how she lacks a sharp edge, making her useless overall in actual battle. And if that wasn't enough, she must also eventually decide who will become her real meister, Anya or Meme, due to the idea of a weapon with two meisters being unheard of and most likely not possible. The overall story revolves around Tsugumi trying to conquer these problems while also simply living her life as a student at the DWMA. A-Cup Angst: She's not too proud of her small bust especially when compared to her companions namely Meme. Catchphrase: In the anime, "Gagantous!" Curtains Match the Window: Her eyes and hair are both colored dark blue in manga pages, but her hair color in the anime was changed to black.

characters.name: Meme Tatane
characters.description: One of Tsugumi's two roommates, and a meister with unimaginable strength and fighting prowess.Ridiculouslyditzy, even forgetting her own name once in a while, but is shown to become serious when either Anya or Tsugumi fall into trouble. What is notable about Meme is that she is the most capable of the three girls in hand-to-hand combat, not even needing a weapon, though she still wishes to become Tsugumi's partner. Brainwashed and Crazy:Thanks to Shaula's mind control. For the most part, she remained in control of her actions, but Shuala effectively used it spy on the DWMA and was able to take control of her body when needed. It's also heavily implied that her terrible memory was a side effect of this, which, if this is true (and the ending of the anime seems to support this), meansshe's been like this for the entirety of the series. Crouching Moron, Hidden Badass: When attacked while she was asleep, she was able to fight off the attacker without waking up. Even when not sleeping she's incredibly fit, being able to jump about a dozen feet to snatch a fast-moving baseball right out of the air. Cloudcuckoolander: She once spent a whole chapter wondering around Death City, carrying a handful of random items that she didn't even remember having in the first place.
